symptom: `return $Parent/Mod.Child_Parent;` in a list-returning microflow passes `mxcli check --references` ("Check passed!"), and `mxcli docker check` reports `[CE0117] "Error(s) in expression." at End event`; `loop $c in $Parent/Mod.Child_Parent` is written with no list, CE0099 "The 'Iterate over' property is required."
cause: MDL049 (bare association path as a value) was applied to call arguments only; the return value is the same shape. The loop grammar accepts `IN attributePath` but buildLoopStatement read only a bare VARIABLE token, so the path was silently dropped and the builder wrote ListVariableName "".
insight: Measure before ruling: the forward/object case `return $Child/M.Child_Parent` is CE0117 too, so the rule is not about lists or direction — a path ENDING on an association is never a whole value, while naming the target entity (`…/M.Child_Parent/M.Parent`, and `…/M.Child_Tag/M.Tag` into a list) is 0 errors, exactly MDL049's existing exemptions. mx check's 'at End event' does not name the microflow: bisect by dropping microflows on copies (two checks in parallel). Measured on 11.12.1 the new checks match mxbuild one-to-one on a 6-microflow probe (4 errors, 4 violations, both clean forms silent); nanoflow return measured the same. DECLARE of a list was already MDL040. A grammar alternative the visitor ignores is a silent drop: grep loop/statement builders for AllVARIABLE() where the rule also admits a path.
